title: Replace magic_link_service_test.dart's 20 fixed-delay waits with a deterministic completion signal
why: This file uses plain test() (no fakeAsync/tester.runAsync wrapper), so all 20 of these are real wall-clock waits used to let the fake uriLinkStream's listener finish processing before the following assertions run. Each adds ~50ms of guaranteed dead time (~1s total for this file), and because 50ms is a guess rather than a guarantee, the assertions are one slow/contended CI runner away from a flaky false failure if the listener callback hasn't finished when the wait ends.
recommendation: Await an explicit completion signal instead — e.g. have the test await a Completer that the fake onSignedIn/mock callback completes, rather than guessing a fixed sleep.
acceptance_criteria: magic_link_service_test.dart's stream-driven tests await an explicit completion signal (e.g. a Completer) instead of a fixed-millisecond Future.delayed
